M5 Missing Kernel Configurations for gfx950
============================================

The following epilogue types have no compiled kernel in
Tensile/client/tests/yaml/gemm_epilogues.yaml for gfx950.  Their GPU test
classes exist in test_gemm_epilogues.py but all test methods issue
pytest.skip() with an explanatory message.

ScaleAlphaVec (UseScaleAlphaVec != 0)
--------------------------------------
Reason: UseScaleAlphaVec kernels require a ProblemType that enables the
ScaleAlphaVec feature (UseScaleAlphaVec=1 or 3).  Adding such a group to
gemm_epilogues.yaml would also require building the Bias slot alongside it
(biasSource=3 triggers factorDim), making the arg-layout test substantially
more complex.  The byte-layout is already verified by
TestBuildKernelArgsEpilogue.test_scale_alpha_vec_adds_8_bytes.  GPU
correctness tests are deferred until a dedicated YAML group is added with
a kernel that isolates UseScaleAlphaVec without co-dependencies.
Affected tests: TestScaleAlphaVecGpu (all four methods).

AmaxD (OutputAmaxD=True)
------------------------
Reason: OutputAmaxD kernels additionally require the AmaxD workspace and
sync pointers (24 extra bytes in the arg layout).  The byte-level layout is
verified by TestBuildKernelArgsEpilogue.test_amax_d_adds_24_bytes.
No gfx950 BenchmarkProblems YAML with OutputAmaxD=True is currently present
in the gemm_epilogues.yaml file; adding one would require building and
benchmarking an entirely new problem group.  GPU correctness tests are
deferred until that group is added.
Affected tests: TestAmaxDGpu (test_amax_d_fp32, test_amax_d_bf16).

ETensor (UseE=True)
-------------------
Reason: UseE kernels write a copy of the pre-cast accumulator to a separate
E tensor.  This requires additional pointer and stride slots in the arg
layout (_buildESlots).  No gfx950 BenchmarkProblems YAML with UseE=True is
currently present in gemm_epilogues.yaml.  GPU correctness tests are deferred
until a suitable YAML group is added.
Affected tests: TestETensorGpu (test_e_tensor_fp32, test_e_tensor_bf16).

Multi-epilogue combinations (bias+Relu, bias+ScaleAB+Gelu, ScaleAB+ScaleCD+AmaxD)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Reason: Kernels that combine multiple epilogue flags simultaneously (e.g.
UseBias=1 AND ActivationType=relu, or UseScaleAB="Scalar" AND UseScaleCD=True
AND OutputAmaxD=True) are not present in gemm_epilogues.yaml.  Each such
combination results in a distinct ProblemType requiring its own BenchmarkProblems
group and associated YAML solutions.  Adding these groups is tracked as a future
enhancement.  The individual epilogue byte-layout tests in
TestBuildKernelArgsEpilogue cover the combined slot ordering
(e.g. test_combined_scale_ab_and_bias verifies ScaleAB+Bias ordering).
Affected tests: TestMultiEpilogueGpu (all six methods).
